verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated documentation index. Per-page .md versions of the docs are served, and each one points agents to the llms.txt index. cubic also ships agent skills that give coding agents instructions for using its context, so agents can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content dump (e.g. llms-full.txt), independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
